newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet unit buys 61 pct of railway IT group.
newsitem.headline: Stet unit buys 61 pct of railway IT group.

text.p: Telecom holding company Stet's data processing arm Finsiel has bought a 61 percent stake in the Italian state railway's information technology division for 125 billion lire, the two firms said in a joint statement.
The deal was originally announced last August and concluded after the anti-trust watchdog gave its approval.
The statement said Finsiel would manage railway group Ferrovie dello Stato's information technology network and develop the market for information services in the transport and tourist sectors.
Ferrovie will maintain strategic control over the company, the statement added.

When it announced the sale last year, Ferrovie said the operation would be worth more than 700 billion lire over the next 10 years, thanks to economies from outsourcing management of the data services, from the value of the sale and from future dividends from the company.

A Treasury under-secretary said earlier this year that Stet, which is due to be privatised in the autumn, should sell off non-core businesses, including "part of Finsiel". -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
